tool.name: State
tool.description: Virtual cell model for perturbation response prediction

param.name: input_h5ad
param.label: Input single-cell data (h5ad)
param.help: AnnData object with baseline cell states

param.name: perturbation
param.label: Perturbation
param.help: Gene name, drug, or CRISPR target to simulate

param.name: cell_type
param.label: Cell type filter
param.help: Optional: filter to specific cell type

tool.help:
**State: Virtual Cell Model**
State is a foundation model from Arc Institute that predicts how cells respond to perturbations.
**Capabilities:** - Predict gene expression changes after drug treatment - Simulate CRISPR knockouts/knockdowns - Model genetic perturbations across cell types
**Inputs:** - Single-cell data (h5ad format) - Perturbation specification (gene, drug, or CRISPR)
**Outputs:** - Predicted cell states after perturbation (h5ad)
**Use Cases:** - Drug response prediction - Target identification - Combinatorial perturbation modeling
**Citation:** Arc Institute (2025). Predicting cellular responses to perturbation across cell types. bioRxiv. DOI: 10.1101/2025.06.26.661135
